title: ctxlint rule catalog
description: Governing schema for the machine-readable rule catalogs that back the ctxlint specifications (context-, mcp-config-, agent-session-, agent-skill-lint-rules.json). Defines the shared metadata block + the rule/category shape every catalog must satisfy. Per-catalog extras (formats, clients, dataSources) are permitted via additionalProperties.

$schema.description: Points at this governing schema so editors and CI validate against it.

title.description: Optional human title for the catalog.

description.description: Optional human description of the catalog's scope.

specVersion.description: Semantic version of the specification this catalog implements.

specDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the spec version was authored/updated.

mcpSpecCompatibility.description: Shared optional field: the Model Context Protocol wire-spec version this catalog tracks (date-stamped, e.g. "2025-11-25"). Present only on catalogs whose rules are bound to the MCP protocol version (mcp-config). Absent (meaningfully) on catalogs that are protocol-agnostic (context, agent-session, agent-skill).

repository.description: Canonical repository URL for the reference implementation.

id.description: Stable rule ID in ctxlint `category/slug` format (a single `/` separator). NOTE: the sibling mcp-compliance project uses `category-suffix` (a `-` separator) instead; the difference is deliberate -- see CONTRIBUTING.md "Rule ID format".

severity.description: The highest severity the rule emits. A rule that emits more than one severity also declares severityByFormat or severityVariants, which say which case gets which.

severityByFormat.description: Per-format severity for a rule whose severity depends only on the file format: format id (as in appliesTo) -> severity.

severityVariants.description: Per-finding severities for a rule whose severity depends on the case it finds. Each entry names the severity, the case, and (when it differs from `message`) the message that case emits.

message.description: The primary message template. Placeholders are {name}.

messageVariants.description: Further message templates the rule emits for other cases, at the rule's severity unless severityVariants says otherwise.

fixDescription.description: What the auto-fix does. Present exactly when fixable is true.
